title: Lab on a Contact Lens Can Measure Stress Through Serotonin
summary: Researchers have developed a smart contact lens that can detect serotonin levels in tears to measure stress in real-time, offering a non-invasive approach to mental health monitoring through wearable biosensor technology.
problem_solved: Enables continuous, non-invasive monitoring of stress hormones through tears using a comfortable wearable device.
why_valuable: Provides a revolutionary way to track mental health and stress levels in real-time without invasive blood tests, potentially transforming personalized healthcare and mental wellness management.
